urdf=ET.parse(e/"context/geometry/LW.urdf").getroot();joints={j.find("child").attrib["link"]:j for j in urdf.findall("joint")}
def rpyR(r,p,y):
 Rx=np.array([[1,0,0],[0,np.cos(r),-np.sin(r)],[0,np.sin(r),np.cos(r)]])
 Ry=np.array([[np.cos(p),0,np.sin(p)],[0,1,0],[-np.sin(p),0,np.cos(p)]])
 Rz=np.array([[np.cos(y),-np.sin(y),0],[np.sin(y),np.cos(y),0],[0,0,1]])
 return Rz@Ry@Rx
n=len(t);cache={}
def fk(link):
 if link in cache:return cache[link]
 if link not in joints:cache[link]=(np.broadcast_to(np.eye(3),(n,3,3)),np.zeros((n,3)));return cache[link]
 j=joints[link];rp,pp=fk(j.find("parent").attrib["link"]);origin=j.find("origin")
 xyz=np.fromstring(origin.attrib.get("xyz","0 0 0"),sep=" ");rpy=np.fromstring(origin.attrib.get("rpy","0 0 0"),sep=" ")
 rr=rpyR(*rpy);p=pp+rp@xyz
 axis=j.find("axis");ax=np.fromstring(axis.attrib["xyz"],sep=" ");ax=ax/np.linalg.norm(ax)
 label=j.attrib["name"].replace("_joint","_now");q=pos[:,names.index(label)] if label in names else np.zeros(n)
 cross=np.array([[0,-ax[2],ax[1]],[ax[2],0,-ax[0]],[-ax[1],ax[0],0]])
 cq=np.cos(q)[:,None,None];sq=np.sin(q)[:,None,None]
 Rq=cq*np.eye(3)+(1-cq)*np.outer(ax,ax)+sq*cross
 R=(rp@rr)@Rq;cache[link]=(R,p);return R,p

counter_metrics: hip torque RMS and sustained mean
candidate_parameter_changes_advisory_onl.purpose: Make centimeter-scale wheel-center displacement matter continuously within the existing band.
candidate_parameter_changes_advisory_onl.risk: Overly narrow center reward may increase bracing or reduce turn/disturbance compliance; do not judge by width alone.

candidate_parameter_changes_advisory_onl.function: sum abs raw hip actions; L1, not square and not physical joint-angle error
candidate_parameter_changes_advisory_onl.purpose: Apply a modest cost to sustained large position targets while retaining nonzero support torque.
candidate_parameter_changes_advisory_onl.risk: A position-PD policy uses target error to support load; excessive regularization can weaken necessary support or worsen balance.

candidate_parameter_changes_advisory_onl.purpose: Include the 20-60s slow-settling behavior in the training state distribution.
candidate_parameter_changes_advisory_onl.risk: Extending episodes changes state sampling and termination statistics; it does not by itself solve bias or guarantee long-horizon credit assignment.

hardware_record.force_measurement: motor-board torque estimates, not calibrated shaft torques
hardware_record.policy_interval_source: wheel-target activity; FSM not directly recorded

limitations: Actual visual shape and wheel-ground positions were not measured; FK estimates assume the archived rigid URDF, whose equality to the training USD has not been independently verified.
Support before policy was confirmed; release time, rope load and support during policy are unknown. No synchronized kick timestamp or video.
Target angles are not actual hip angles. A broad target-feedback gap under loaded position PD can deliver necessary support torque.
Native comparisons reuse completed zero-command runs; they differ from the hardware command/support history and do not isolate any one observation-noise channel.
No approved before/after training-parameter intervention or acceptance thresholds; advice is an initial test design, not a proven optimum.
